To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a multifaceted strategy for the implementation of the guideline for the prevention mental ill-health at workplace within schools is more effective than a single strategy in terms of implementation effectiveness and intervention effectiveness.

a multifaceted strategy consisting of an educational meeting, an Implementation Team and a series of implementation workshops is more effective in implementing a guideline for prevention of mental ill health at the workplace than an educational meeting alone.
a multifaceted strategy is more effective than a single strategy in the implementation of the Guideline for prevention of mental ill health at the workplace within primary schools.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the translation of guidelines to practice, and the effects of this translation on social and organizational risk-factors for mental ill-health and absenteeism.
the implementation of a guideline to prevent common mental disorders within primary schools.
how to implement the Swedish Guideline in schools, and how to measure the effects of the guideline.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the study described in this paper will provide knowledge on the effects of a multifacated implementation strategy for implementing a Swedish occupational guideline for the prevention common mental disorders within school.

the study described in this study-protocol aims to compare the effectiveness (i.e. guideline adherence and reduction in social and organisational factors for mental ill health, absenteeism and/or presenteeism) of a multifacatalistic strategy versus a single strategy for implementing a guideline to prevent mental health problems at work among primary school personnel.

the implementation strategies tested in this study are likely to be successful in reducing social and organizational risk-factors and mental ill-health at schools, and that the multifaceted implementation package is superior to the educational strategy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are implementing the Swedish Guideline in schools, using a multifaceted strategy and a single strategy.
the implementation of the Swedish guideline for prevention of mental ill health at the workplace in schools was successful.

the implementation of a multifacatalistic strategy for implementing the Swedish guideline for the prevention mental ill-health at workplace is effective in reducing social and organizational risk factor and mental ill-health and that the implementation of the single implementation strategy is less effective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to be careful about how we define and measure implementation.
the implementation of a multifacatalised implementation strategy is more effective in terms of guideline adherence and mental health outcomes than a single educational implementation strategy.
we have developed a multifaceted strategy for implementation of a Swedish occupational health guideline for prevention of mental health problems at the workplace.
